create_imgpil2labtensor: create an ImgPil2LabTensor transform that converts a PIL image to a LAB tensor of shape C x H x W
call_imgpil2labtensor: call the ImgPil2LabTensor transform on a PIL image to get a float LAB tensor output
build_from_config: build an ImgPil2LabTensor instance from a configuration dictionary using from_config
convertbgr2lab: convert a BGR uint8 image to rescaled LAB float32 with L [0,100], A [-128,127], B [-128,127]
register_transform: register ImgPil2LabTensor as a named transform using the @register_transform decorator
